_doc: A development case pack (crates/cathedral-sim/src/inquiry.rs), not shipped content: nothing loads it unless a host is told to, e.g. `cathedral-headless --cases assets/world/dev_cases.json`. Two small disputes among people of Coswald's Yard, with the bencher Ewart Toll (bn9et) reviewing both at High Wick. `facts` rows have the facts.json shape and must name people and places of this world; each witness has an `own` line, because a standing fact reaches anybody else's sheet as a dim memory. `retold` puts a fact in the mouth of somebody who was not there: `by` had it from `from`, `day_offset` days out. An inquiry's facts must be standing and authored, and `sources_needed` counts people who were there, however many mouths repeat them. dev_scaffold is cleared by its two independent witnesses. dev_barrow is the correlated-rumour trap: Clemence and Ewart Crake both repeat Noll, and she has the day wrong; Noll's own account settles the day and Dunstan's is the second source. A fact id's segments are the words an asker will use (scaffold, barrow).

facts.said: the scaffold pole that came down behind the lodge had rotted through at the foot, and nobody was near it when it fell

own.b6clm: I was at the kiln when the scaffold pole came down behind the lodge, rotted through at the foot, with nobody near it
own.b5ewk: I watched the scaffold pole behind the lodge go over from where I sat, and it was the rot at its foot and no hand that did it

facts.said: the lime barrow was fetched from the kiln gate by the carter it was promised to, {day}

own.b0nll: I wheeled the lime barrow to the kiln gate myself and gave it to the carter it was promised to, {day}
own.bd7hb: I saw the carter take the lime barrow from the kiln gate, {day}, and it was his to take

inquiries.title: The scaffold pole that fell behind the lodge
inquiries.finding: The pole fell by rot and by no hand. Nobody is to answer for it.

inquiries.title: The lime barrow gone from the kiln gate
inquiries.finding: The barrow was fetched by the carter it was promised to, on the day its two witnesses name. Nothing was stolen.
